Web JavaScript Guide Working with objects

open_graph.og:title: Working with objects - JavaScript | MDN
open_graph.og:description: JavaScript is designed on an object-based paradigm. An object is a collection of properties, and a property is an association between a name (or key) and a value. A property's value can be a function, in which case the property is known as a method.
